{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[Tomrus]]' '''father''' was born on a colony in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] before moving to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] with his [[Tomrus' mother|wife]]. They lived on the floating city for several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], raising their son until the [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] of the city by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. His wife was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the evacuation, and he retired back to his homeworld while his son joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
